Wheels are shown with grey tyres in the final picture. The wheel holders are on the black base plates in step 1, and the wheels are fitted in steps 5-8, so each wheel is attached to a holder on the nearest base plate.
Emma is built as four parts (hair, head, torso, skirt/legs) and seated in the car in step 8. Her legs are attached to a seat piece (b4).
